name: 89139 · Las Vegas, NV
findings: ZIP 89139 (Las Vegas) has 77 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 89139 (Las Vegas) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 89139 (Las Vegas) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 53% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 38 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
